versoes.objetivos: To allow the student to develop elementary accounting competencies (knowledge, skills and attitudes).
versoes.programa: The course focuses initially on how to record economic events in the accounting records (i.e., bookkeeping and accrual accounting) and how to prepare and interpret the primary financial statements that summarize a firm's economic transactions (i.e., the balance sheet, the income statement, and the statement of cash flows).
versoes.avaliacao: Based on homework readings and assignments, tests, and course/class participation.
versoes.bibliografia:
Latest editions of the following textbooks:

Financial accounting for dummies. Maire Loughran.
Financial Accounting: an introduction to concepts, methods, and uses. Roman L. Weil, Katherine Schipper, and
Jennifer Francis.

Other textbooks may be used for instructions.
